facts.fact: 老年 Isabel 疲惫不堪，Nick 来得更频繁，她早已知道他还没放过她。
facts.anchor: I grow weary. Nick visits more often

facts.fact: Nick 说地狱不是她想象的那样。
facts.anchor: Hell is not what you think it is

facts.fact: Nick 独白：地狱里只有现在，没有过去与未来；人以为脑中的声音是自己，其实可能是他派来的虫。
facts.anchor: There is nothing but the present there, no past, no future

facts.fact: 她发现关于 Nick 的记忆越来越模糊，怀疑是他动了手脚。
facts.anchor: I think Nick has had quite the hand in turning things hazy

facts.fact: Nick 说她临终对 Alexander 说的那番话是漂亮的小把戏；她以为他会报复，但他只是悲伤又认命。
facts.anchor: It was a neat little trick you pulled there at the end

facts.fact: 她如今对死亡既更怕又更不怕，望着窗外等乌鸦来访。
facts.anchor: I am both more afraid and less afraid of death now

facts.fact: 她梦见握着他的手直到他死去，清晨又埋了一只乌鸦的尸体。
facts.anchor: In my dreams I held his hand as he died and buried a crow corpse in the morning

facts.fact: 结尾：她确信 Nick 还会来，愿意再做最后一笔交易。
facts.anchor: I am sure he will be willing to make one more deal
